technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with multiple bullish indicators (MACD crossover, Hull flip, three white soldiers, OBV rising) but overbought conditions (RSI-9, Stoch-K) and price below VWAP create pullback risk; suitable for swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: COO shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from junior member small sales over 7+ months, neutral market sentiment with balanced fear/greed, insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (179.4) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just occurred; earnings in 28 days adds moderate event risk but healthcare sector may provide defensive shelter.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (MACD crossover, Hull flip, RSI momentum) with price near support (87.54) offers defined risk entry for swing trade with tight stops.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 179.4), zero fundamental support, overbought technicals (RSI 72.76, Stoch-K 80.49), price below VWAP, and 28-day earnings event create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
